about: Tracadie is a regional municipality on New Brunswick’s Acadian Peninsula, facing the Gulf of St. Lawrence around Tracadie Bay. Amalgamated coastal and inland communities share beaches, fishing harbours, and a strongly Francophone Acadian culture. Highway 11 is the peninsula’s main spine. About 16,000 people live in Tracadie.
